# Knowt

> > Knowt is a comprehensive flashcard and study platform covering academic subjects from neuroscience and anatomy to world history and language learning.

Knowt provides user-generated flashcard sets for students across diverse disciplines including medical sciences (anatomy, physiology, immunology), social sciences (psychology, history), languages (Spanish, Vietnamese), and professional certifications (DECA, NDT). The platform supports learning through digital flashcards optimized for exam preparation and concept mastery.

## Key Topics

- Neuroscience and Learning Memory
- Human Anatomy and Physiology
- Synaptic Plasticity
- Immunology (T cells, B cells)
- AP World History
- Spanish Vocabulary
- Cardiovascular Pharmacology
- Declarative Memory and Amnesia
- Spinal Cord Anatomy
- Language Learning Flashcards
- WWII History (Churchill, Stalin)
- Biology and Evolution
- Medical Terminology
- DECA Business Management
- Memory Systems and Conditioning
